card: The Platinum Card from American Express
notes: Post-2025 refresh terms from the US product page; Saks credit no longer listed (dropped 2026); Global Entry credit and Sky Club year do not fit the cadence enum.

entitlements.name: Hotel credit (FHR / Hotel Collection)

trigger.channel: prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection via Amex Travel

entitlements.limits: $300 per half-year (Jan-Jun, Jul-Dec); Hotel Collection needs a 2-night minimum stay; prepaid rates only.
entitlements.source_excerpt: get up to $300 back in statement credits semi-annually for up to a total of $600 per year on prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts ® or The Hotel Collection

entitlements.name: Uber Cash

trigger.channel: Uber app with Platinum Card added

entitlements.limits: $15/mo Jan-Nov, $35 in Dec ($15 + $20 bonus); U.S. rides/orders only; paid as Uber Cash, not a statement credit; unused month does not roll over.
entitlements.source_excerpt: start receiving $15 in Uber Cash each month, plus a bonus $20 in December, to use on rides and orders in the U.S.

entitlements.name: Uber One membership credit
entitlements.limits: Auto-renewing Uber One membership charged to the Card; up to $120 per calendar year.
entitlements.source_excerpt: up to $120 in statement credits each calendar year after you purchase an auto-renewing Uber One membership with the Card

entitlements.name: Airline incidental fee credit
entitlements.limits: Must select one qualifying airline (selection, not classic enrollment); incidentals only (bags, seat/lounge day passes, in-flight items, change fees), not tickets; credit can take up to 8 weeks.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Select one qualifying airline and then receive up to $200 in statement credits per calendar year when incidental fees, such as checked bags

entitlements.name: CLEAR+ credit
entitlements.limits: Auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership; excludes taxes and fees.
entitlements.source_excerpt: up to $219 in statement credits per calendar year after you sign up and pay for a CLEAR+ Membership (subject to auto-renewal)

entitlements.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck fee credit
entitlements.limits: Recurs every 4 years for Global Entry ($120) or per 5-year TSA PreCheck application (up to $85 via official provider); value is per cycle, NOT annual. Cadence enum has no multi-year option.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Receive either a statement credit every 4 years after you apply for Global Entry ($120) or a statement credit after you apply for a five-year membership for TSA PreCheck

entitlements.name: Resy dining credit
entitlements.limits: $100 per calendar quarter; U.S. Resy restaurants only; unused quarter does not roll over.
entitlements.source_excerpt: get up to $100 in statement credits each quarter after you use the Platinum Card ® to make eligible purchases with Resy

entitlements.name: Digital entertainment credit
entitlements.limits: $25 per month; partner list subject to change.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get up to $25 in statement credits each month when you use your Platinum Card ® for eligible purchases

entitlements.name: lululemon credit

trigger.channel: U.S. lululemon stores (not outlets) and lululemon.com

entitlements.limits: $75 per calendar quarter; outlets excluded.
entitlements.source_excerpt: up to $75 in statement credits each quarter when you use the Card for eligible purchases at U.S. lululemon retail stores (excluding outlets) and lululemon.com

entitlements.name: Walmart+ membership credit
entitlements.limits: Up to $12.95 plus tax per month for one auto-renewing monthly Walmart+ membership (annual plan not covered).
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get up to a $12.95* statement credit back each month after you pay for a monthly Walmart+ membership (subject to auto-renewal)

entitlements.name: Oura Ring credit
entitlements.limits: Ring hardware purchased at ouraring.com; up to $200 per calendar year.
entitlements.source_excerpt: up to $200 in statement credits when you use the Platinum Card ® to purchase an Oura Ring at ouraring.com each calendar year. Enrollment required.

entitlements.name: Equinox credit
entitlements.limits: Equinox club membership or Equinox+ digital subscription, auto-renewing.
entitlements.source_excerpt: up to $300 in statement credits each calendar year after you pay with your Platinum Card ® for an Equinox club membership or Equinox+ digital subscription

entitlements.name: Venue Collection concessions rebate

trigger.channel: select American Express Venue Collection stadiums and arenas

entitlements.limits: 10% back on qualifying concessions, capped at $250 back per calendar year; one enrolled Card per Card Member. Not a fixed credit, so value is null.
entitlements.source_excerpt: enroll your Card and get 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases up to $250 per calendar year. Limit one enrolled Card per Card Member.

entitlements.name: 5X on flights

trigger.channel: directly with airlines or via Amex Travel

entitlements.limits: Capped at $500,000 of these purchases per calendar year, then 1X.
entitlements.source_excerpt: 5X Points on Flights Booked directly with airlines or through American Express Travel ® , on up to $500,000 on these purchases per calendar year.

entitlements.name: 5X on prepaid hotels via Amex Travel
entitlements.limits: Prepaid bookings only.
entitlements.source_excerpt: 5X Membership Rewards ® points on prepaid hotels booked on AmexTravel.com.

entitlements.name: 1X on everything else
entitlements.source_excerpt: 1X Membership Rewards ® points on all other Purchases.

entitlements.name: Centurion Lounge access
entitlements.limits: Guest rules not captured here; check lounge terms.
entitlements.source_excerpt: access to Centurion Lounges, 10 Delta Sky Club visits when flying on an eligible Delta flight, Priority Pass membership (enrollment required)

entitlements.name: Priority Pass membership
entitlements.limits: Guest policy and restaurant exclusions not captured.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Priority Pass membership (enrollment required), and other select partner lounges.

entitlements.name: Delta Sky Club visits
entitlements.limits: 10 visits per year (year starts Feb 1, i.e. Delta's Feb-Jan year, not calendar year); unlimited after $75,000 eligible spend in prior calendar year; extra visits $50 each.
entitlements.source_excerpt: *Effective 2/1/25, Platinum Card Members will receive 10 Visits per year to the Delta Sky Club; to earn an unlimited number of Visits each year starting on 2/1/25

entitlements.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite
entitlements.limits: Enrollment through Amex is expected but not stated on the product page.
entitlements.source_excerpt: With Marriott Bonvoy ® Gold Elite status, you can receive upgrades to enhanced rooms upon check-in when available.

entitlements.name: Hilton Honors Gold
entitlements.source_excerpt: As a Platinum Card ® Member, you are eligible to enroll in complimentary Hilton Honors Gold status.

entitlements.name: Leaders Club Sterling (Leading Hotels of the World)

merchants: The Leading Hotels of the World

entitlements.limits: Includes 5 pre-arrival upgrades per year (subject to availability).
entitlements.source_excerpt: you can receive complimentary Leaders Club Sterling Status from The Leading Hotels of the World ® . ... Enrollment required.

entitlements.name: Car rental status (Avis, Hertz, National)
entitlements.limits: Tier details only visible in the account.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Card Members must enroll through their American Express online account using their eligible Card.

entitlements.name: Fine Hotels + Resorts benefits

trigger.channel: Fine Hotels + Resorts via Amex Travel

entitlements.limits: Per stay: breakfast for two, upgrade when available, $100 property credit, 4pm checkout, noon check-in when available.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Benefits include: Daily breakfast for two Room upgrade upon arrival when available ... $100 credit towards eligible charges

entitlements.name: The Hotel Collection benefits

trigger.channel: The Hotel Collection via Amex Travel, 2+ nights

entitlements.limits: $100 property credit per booking of 2+ nights.
entitlements.source_excerpt: receive a $100 credit towards eligible charges* with every booking of two nights or more through AmexTravel.com.

entitlements.name: No foreign transaction fees
entitlements.source_excerpt: when you use your Platinum Card ® there are no foreign transaction fees.

entitlements.name: Car rental loss and damage insurance
entitlements.limits: Secondary coverage, no liability; must decline the rental CDW; not in Australia, Italy, New Zealand. Coverage cap not stated on page.
entitlements.source_excerpt: This product provides secondary coverage and does not include liability coverage.

entitlements.name: Trip delay insurance
entitlements.limits: Round trip paid entirely with the Card; delay over 6 hours; up to $500 per trip; max 2 claims per 12 months.
entitlements.source_excerpt: a covered reason delays your trip more than 6 hours, Trip Delay Insurance ‡ can help reimburse certain additional expenses ... up to $500 per trip

entitlements.name: Trip cancellation and interruption insurance
entitlements.limits: Round trip paid entirely with the Card; up to $10,000 per trip, $20,000 per Card per 12 months.
entitlements.source_excerpt: reimburse your non-refundable expenses purchased with the same Eligible Card, up to $10,000 per trip and up to $20,000 per Eligible Card per 12 consecutive month period.

entitlements.name: Cell phone protection
entitlements.limits: Prior month's wireless bill paid with the Card; up to $800 per claim, 2 claims per 12 months, $50 deductible.
entitlements.source_excerpt: maximum of up to $800 per claim with a limit of 2 approved claims per 12-month period

entitlements.name: Purchase protection
entitlements.limits: Theft, accidental damage or loss within 90 days; up to $10,000 per item, $50,000 per calendar year.
entitlements.source_excerpt: *Up to $10,000 per Covered Purchase, up to $50,000 per calendar year.

entitlements.name: Return protection
entitlements.limits: Within 90 days if seller won't take it back; up to $300 per item, $1,000 per calendar year; U.S. purchases only.
entitlements.source_excerpt: up to $300 per item, up to a maximum of $1,000 per calendar year per Card account

entitlements.name: Extended warranty
entitlements.limits: Adds up to 1 year to manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less; up to $10,000 per item, $50,000 per year.
entitlements.source_excerpt: can provide up to one extra year added to the Original Manufacturer’s Warranty. Applies to warranties of 5 years or less.
